# Launch window sync with Jordan

`start` and `end` are RFC 3339 with the zone the meeting was booked in. A `requested` meeting has no time yet; `para meeting schedule` sets it. Para stores meetings and lists them in `para agenda`. It does not write a calendar, record, or transcribe.

## Notes

Added by `para meeting hold`: what was said, in your words, and the action items as tasks.
